source.name: Honda Global: Sponsorship Agreement Reached with LCR Honda; Full-Season MotoGP Entry as Pro Honda LCR

source.name: SOLIZE: Castrol Honda LCR and Pro Honda LCR Conclude Sponsorship Agreement for the 2026 MotoGP Season
source.quote: the SOLIZE Group logo will appear on the front fenders of both machines ridden by Johann Zarco of Castrol Honda LCR and Diogo Moreira of Pro Honda LCR

summary: Castrol and Pro Honda are the title sponsors of the two 2026 bikes (Zarco and Moreira); SOLIZE Group's logo is on both bikes' front fenders. Not complete: other small partner logos on the livery and leathers are not sourced.
